segments.title: 81.5 million travel. How many FLY?
segments.say: Eighty one and a half million Americans travel for Thanksgiving. How many fly? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: About 6 MILLION!
segments.say: About six million! Five point nine six million.

segments.title: Most of them DRIVE
segments.say: Most drive: seventy two point nine million by car.

segments.title: Source: AAA forecast
segments.say: That's AAA's forecast for this week.
Follow for Guess It number 25 tomorrow.
